Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: GCash debuts on stock market with record P60.9-B IPO

blocks.text: GCash makes its landmark stock market debut on Tuesday, October 20, raising a record P60.9-B through its initial public offering.

items: Senate panel approves proposed 2027 OVP budget in under 20 minutes

blocks.text: It took less than 20 minutes for the proposed P785.2-million budget of the Office of the Vice President for 2027 to pass the Senate Finance sub-panel Tuesday, October 20.

items: Senate resolution seeks to declare Chinese envoy ‘persona non grata’

blocks.text: Senator Erwin Tulfo files a resolution seeking to declare Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan a ‘persona non grata.’

items: Palace defends new urban poor commissioner

blocks.text: The Malacanang defends Zofia Canlas who just became a commissioner of the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor.

items: Alex Eala kicks off Ningbo Open campaign with win over Diane Parry

blocks.text: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala gets off to a strong start at the Ningbo Open in China as she defeats France’s Diane Parry, 6-3, 6-1, in the round-of-32 match on Monday, October 19. – Rappler.com
